name: Universal Logistics - Roanoke/Botetourt Value-Added Facility - Cloverdale VA

fieldNotes.siteResolution: Confirmed via PRNewswire, Roanoke Times, Commercial Property Executive, WSET and LoopNet as Universal Logistics' Roanoke/Botetourt value-added facility at 1796 Lee Hwy, Cloverdale VA 24077 - a ~254,000 sq ft warehouse on 37 acres, a former Southern States Cooperative distribution center, acquired by Universal for a ~$50M heavy-truck-division expansion (third-party assembly, sequencing, value-added services) announced Jan 2024. Roster coords landed on the building roof; locked center 37.37224,-79.90340.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The main truck driveway enters the property off Lee Hwy (US-11) at the SW corner. Street View (2023-2024) of the entrance shows an OPEN driveway running into the paved yard - no barrier arm, no sliding/swing gate across the truck lane, no checkpoint pinch-point. A small green swing gate is visible on a minor side path but it does not control the main truck drive. truckGate = false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at the entrance in any Street View pass. guardShack = false; remoteGs = false (no gate, so remoteGs cannot be true).
fieldNotes.perimeterFence: Partial chain-link fencing surrounds the SW staging/equipment lot, but the truck entrance itself is uncontrolled - consistent with an older co-op DC recently acquired and still being built out.
fieldNotes.docks: Dock doors run along the long W/SW face of the warehouse; z19 imagery shows a continuous bank of doors with ~14 trailers backed in / parked. Estimated ~26 doors (flagged uncertain - older building, dock canopies partly obscure the count).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Lee Hwy entrance across the SW staging lot before reaching the dock apron - holds a 3+ truck queue. drivewayLong = true; postGateStaging = true (the large paved SW lot serves as an internal holding area).
fieldNotes.dropYard: A paved SW staging lot holds parked trailers and heavy equipment (a crane visible in Street View) separate from the active dock apron - dedicated drop/equipment yard character. dropArea 10-25, dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main structure is one large warehouse; a separate small office/support building sits just south of it - counted as 2. Not a true multi-building campus, so multipleFacilities = false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NE-SW immediately east of the building behind a vegetation buffer, but no rail spur enters the property - no rail siding visible serving the warehouse. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cloverdale is a small unincorporated community in Botetourt County; the facility sits in an edge-of-town setting with residential frontage and woods/farmland around. Classified Rural.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: The facility was mid-expansion as of the 2024 announcement; current imagery may predate completion of new value-added/assembly buildout, which could change dock and yard counts.
